outcome: Onset of labor (spontaneous, elective cesarean section, induction)
cohort: The study included all births registered in Sweden between 1992 and 2019, totaling 2,931,140 individuals.
finding: There was no strong relationship between obstetric volume and maternal outcomes, with lower odds of PPH observed for women birthing in low and medium volume hospitals compared to high-volume hospitals.
mod_finding: Compared to high-volume hospitals, there was no significant difference in labor starting by elective cesarean section or induction, rather than spontaneously, among low and medium volume hospitals.
gest_age: >=37 weeks gestation (for PPH and OASIS analyses)
